universe.canonical_jsonl: DuckDB read_parquet(file_row_number=true), row_idx 0..499; required string columns in declared order; compact UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=false and LF after every row
universe.acquisition_rule: download exact revision Parquet and pinned DuckDB gzip; verify both before conversion; rerun conversion after hashes are frozen

selection_seed_input: fixed literal ctx-holdout-selection-v1 NUL external dataset revision

static_candidate_rules.production_patch: 1-3 Python files outside test, docs, examples, scripts, benchmarks, migrations, setup, and generated paths; no rename or copy metadata
static_candidate_rules.test_patch: exactly one Python test file and no other files; no rename or copy metadata

ranking.repository_algorithm: sha256(selection_seed NUL canonical_repo_url), ascending then canonical_repo_url
ranking.candidate_algorithm: sha256(selection_seed NUL instance_id), ascending then instance_id

selection.first_scenario_rule: first ranked candidate from each of the first five ranked eligible repositories
selection.sixth_scenario_rule: first disjoint candidate after the first candidate in the first ranked repository
selection.disjoint_means: production and test path sets do not intersect
selection.canary_rule: first ranked candidate from the sixth ranked eligible repository
selection.task: exact problem_statement bytes from the frozen dataset row

control_requirements: parent plus reconstructed test patch is red
reference production patch makes the same test green
the complete changed test module passes with the reference patch
the complete reconstructed selected test module passes the AST dependency validator before execution freeze
verification finishes within the frozen timeout
all seven selected scenarios pass or the protocol is no-go
freeze_manifest_requirements: raw parquet and canonical selection JSONL
selection output and private seven-scenario pack
reconstructed-test-dependency-v1 attestation for all seven selected test modules
holdout-control-results-v1 red, green, complete-module, and timeout evidence for all seven scenarios
product revision, catalog, runtime pack, benchmark runner, and evaluator
model, provider, Codex version, Python, dependency freeze, timeouts, token and iteration limits
execution-freeze commit created before any selected-task model or CTX query

pre_execution_blinding.allowed_before_freeze: deterministic local selection, repository checkout, test reconstruction, red/green control validation, and runtime-pack-distinctive-evidence-v1 collision scanning only
pre_execution_blinding.forbidden_before_freeze: submitting selected or canary identifiers, repositories, tasks, tests, patches, or reference patches to CTX, its recommendation surfaces, skills, MCPs, agents, telemetry, dashboards, or either model arm
pre_execution_blinding.collision_scan: runtime-pack-distinctive-evidence-v1 checks exact scenario ID, repository, commit, test path, and distinctive task, test, reference-patch, and context fragments against the frozen runtime availability pack
pre_execution_blinding.collision_outcome: protocol no-go with no candidate replacement
pre_execution_blinding.invalidation: any forbidden exposure before the complete execution-freeze commit, or any exposure-informed change, requires a new seed, protocol, and holdout

canary_policy.required: one baseline and ctx-light pair with retries disabled
canary_policy.pass: both arms preserve quality, usage is exact, isolation and containment pass, lifecycle ends empty, and incidents are zero
canary_policy.invalidation: any canary-informed change to product, ranking, prompt, model, provider, environment, evaluator, timeout, limits, harness, or dependencies requires a new seed, protocol, and holdout

analysis.population: eligible tasks selected by this protocol from the pinned SWE-bench Verified revision, using the frozen model, provider, product, catalog, and execution environment
analysis.pair_effect: ctx-light divided by baseline within each complete paired trial
analysis.scenario_effect: median pair effect with no outlier removal
analysis.repository_effect: equal-weight median of scenario effects in that repository
analysis.overall_token_effect: equal-weight median of the five repository uncached-provider-token effects
analysis.overall_time_effect: equal-weight median of the five repository total-seconds effects
analysis.support_test: exact one-sided sign test across five repository effects
analysis.failure_policy: any missing pair, failed control, failed quality check, unresolved incident, unavailable token total, or unverified policy outcome makes the claim fail
analysis.quality: every focused and regression verification passes in both arms with the expected test count
analysis.delivery: at least one trusted verified CTX delivery in every repository
analysis.claim_scope: results support only the declared eligible population and frozen execution conditions; broader software-development productivity claims are unsupported

claim_gates.benefiting_repository_definition: repository uncached-provider-token effect is strictly less than 1.0
